high_level_description: stc brand style, a daytime outdoor photograph of an elderly man in a traditional white thobe and checkered ghutra kneeling by a riverbank to touch the water.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A sandy, rocky riverbank landscape with a calm body of water, green trees and bushes, a grassy hill in the distance, and a bright blue sky with wispy white clouds.

elements.desc: An elderly Middle Eastern man wearing a white thobe, a red and white checkered ghutra, and dark blue shoes, kneeling on rocky ground and reaching down to touch the water's surface.
